title: Proper circulant weighing matrix CW(105, 6^2)
statement: Find a proper circulant weighing matrix CW(105,36): a circulant 105 x 105 matrix W with entries -1, 0, 1 and W W^T = 36 I whose first row's support is not inside a coset of a proper subgroup of Z_105 (an improper one comes from a smaller order). Its existence is Open in D. Gordon's La Jolla repository. A valid first row scores 1 and settles the case.
submission: Text file: the first row, 105 entries -1, 0, 1 separated by spaces (or the characters -, 0, +).
score: 1 for a proper CW of these parameters; none is known, so the best known value is 0

best_known.source: CW(105,6^2) has status Open in the La Jolla Circulant Weighing Matrix Repository (D. Gordon; cwm.json at commit 5b3d729, 24 Apr 2026, entry CW(105,6)); read 8 Nov 2026
